title: Transfer: Grade-Aware Hill Descent Governor
goal: Implement a grade-aware hill descent governor for a loaded vehicle that reads slope and target-speed profiles from CSV, uses tuned PID control to blend braking authority over long downhill segments, and proves overspeed, settling, and safety-limit compliance in simulation outputs.
skillBenefitRationale: Transfers the same core skills into disturbance-rejection control: YAML-configured vehicle parameters, CSV terrain/profile ingestion, PID tuning, longitudinal vehicle-dynamics simulation with acceleration constraints, and metric calculation over simulated trajectories.
